warning: Red: the 60 refuge polygons of the Missouri Department of Conservation (closed to all public use from Oct 15 on the dates of 3 CSR 10-11.115(5), or as the layer comment says; MDC outlines), Lake Girardeau CA (no waterfowl hunting) and Schell-Osage CA (waterfowl hunting closed this season). Amber: the managed waterfowl areas (reservation / morning drawing, daily tag, closed Dec 25), areas hunted by managed hunt only, Little River (Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun), Little Bean Marsh and any MDC refuge polygon whose dates the layer does not give. Outlines marked approximate are whole conservation areas: the closed or restricted part is smaller, so follow the signs. Not drawn: the Waterfowl Hunting Only Zones (Oct 15-Feb 15) and hunting pools inside the managed areas, Smithville Lake Waterfowl Refuge, Melvin Price Pool 26 refuge (Upper Mississippi CA), Fellows Lake, the Nodaway River refuge reach, and Corps of Engineers lake rules. Always check the current regulations.
source: Missouri Department of Conservation 2026-27 Migratory Bird and Waterfowl Hunting Digest (printed June 2026; 3 CSR 10-11, 10-12); MDC GIS Refuges layer (gisblue.mdc.mo.gov Aquatic/Waterfowl_Drawing); MDC Conservation Area Boundaries.

areas.n: B.K. Leach Memorial - managed waterfowl area
areas.d: Managed waterfowl hunting area (MDC digest pp. 26-28): hunting locations are given by online reservation (Missouri residents) and a morning drawing ("poor line") each hunt day; parties of up to four; a Daily Waterfowl Hunting Tag is required and hunters check out after the hunt; hunting only from the assigned blind or location; the area is closed to waterfowl hunting on December 25 (3 CSR 10-11.186(4)); lead shot is prohibited (3 CSR 10-11.180(8)). Closing time (1 p.m. or sunset, by part of the area) is in the digest table on p. 28, which could not be tied to rows in the text: see the MDC area page. APPROXIMATE: whole conservation area.
